class_definitions.RETRY_SAFE: The documented behaviour shows the request was rejected and the message was NOT accepted (for example rate-limit/throttle rejections). Retry only with backoff/jitter and honouring Retry-After.
class_definitions.OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: The message may or may not have been accepted (HTTP 5xx, timeouts, connection resets, any response the docs don't clearly describe as rejected). Never auto-retry. S9 records UNKNOWN_NEEDS_REVIEW and reconciles through webhook evidence.
class_definitions.OPERATOR_ACTION: Cannot be fixed by retrying; needs a human or configuration change (auth/token errors, payment, account/phone-number state, quality/flagged state, template paused/rejected, missing permissions).
class_definitions.PERMANENT: The request is invalid or the recipient/message can never succeed as sent (malformed payload, unsupported type, undeliverable, window expired for free-form).
class_definitions.UNKNOWN: The docs do not say. Default to OUTCOME_UNKNOWN behaviour.

retry_guidance.webhook_delivery_retry_policy: Meta retries delivery with decreasing frequency until the request succeeds, for up to 7 days.

idempotency.required_client_safeguard: Client must maintain internal dispatch state machine and deduplicate on local job ID before any retry attempt to prevent duplicate messaging and charges. OUTCOME_UNKNOWN failures require reconciliation via webhook evidence, never a blind retry.

webhook_semantics.retry_frequency: decreasing frequency for up to 7 days

audio.voice_note_format: audio/ogg (OPUS codecs only; base audio/ogg not supported; mono input only)
audio.sampling_rate_hz_note: 48000 Hz is standard Opus RFC 7845 / FFmpeg convention; Meta documentation specifies 'OPUS codecs only; base audio/ogg not supported; mono input only' without stating sampling rate.
